briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and xAI Grok-4 escalate multi-agent reasoning race amid safety gaps

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple reasoning models this month while compute buildouts accelerate. Regulatory pressure mounts on export controls and model evaluations. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-2 with 4.2T parameters; xAI launched Grok-4 achieving 92% on SWE-bench. DeepSeek-R2 and Meta Llama-4-405B followed within days. Anthropic Claude 4 Opus leads in constitutional alignment benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New jailbreak techniques bypass GPT-5o guardrails in 34% of tests. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA shipped 1.2M Blackwell GPUs this quarter. Google and Microsoft announced 50GW data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC 2nm yields reached 65% for AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-weight models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2028?
